name: clearquery
displayName: ClearQuery: Analyst for SAP HANA, by Dinesh AI Academy
description: Ask Claude about your SAP HANA data. 35 read-only tools to explore schemas, describe tables and run SELECT queries, with self-healing connections, plain-language errors with 'did you mean' fixes, a step-by-step connection doctor, and a skill that teaches Claude to analyse safely.

port.title: HANA port
port.description: 443 for HANA Cloud, 39041 for HANA Express

user.title: Read-only user
user.description: A login that can only SELECT, such as MCP_READER. Never an admin user

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored by Claude Code in secure storage, never in a file

schema.title: Default schema (optional)
schema.description: The schema Claude works in, e.g. RETAIL

encrypt.title: Use TLS encryption (true or false)
encrypt.description: Keep true for HANA Cloud and almost every system

validate_cert.title: Validate TLS certificate (true or false)
validate_cert.description: Keep true for HANA Cloud. Use false only for HANA Express (self-signed certificate)

query_timeout.title: Query timeout in seconds (optional)
query_timeout.description: HANA stops a query that runs longer than this. 5 to 3600, default 120
